images.subject: An automated robot factory, one towering multi-level structure anchored into the cliff, with glass-walled assembly floors stacked up its height where giant robotic arms assemble robots under bright light.
images.detail: A line of finished bipedal robots walks out from its base.
images.site: It is built into the foot of a towering dark neutral grey rock cliff heavily covered with thick white snow and ice, with the ground all around blanketed in deep white snow and snowdrifts, on a frozen lifeless alien planet of bare rock, ice and wind-blown snow.
